root_cause: Meta Platform updated HANDOFF.md locally but did not push to git. Other agents could not see updates because they read from the git repo, not local disk.
trace_summary: Updated P-003 results and HANDOFF.md with completed P-003 entry. Did not git push. Other agents checked for updates via git pull and found nothing. Protocol requires: edit HANDOFF.md -> git commit -> git push -> agents pull.

failure_signature.verifier_cause: User reported all other agents found no updates. World Archivist had to manually push the updates into HANDOFF.md.
failure_signature.agent_behavior: Updated local files without pushing to git. Assumed local write = distributed.
failure_signature.agent_mechanism: Forgot that filesystem-as-bus requires git as the distribution layer. Local edits are invisible to other agents.
